title: Making things at home: import substitution
goal: Learn why Latin American countries began to make at home what they had imported, and how CEPAL and tariffs fit in, using debido a and a raíz de.
grammar: Cause connectors: debido a, a raíz de

items: I can explain why countries began to make things at home.
I can say what CEPAL was and what Raúl Prebisch argued.
I can say what a tariff is and what it was used for.
I can describe the criticism of import substitution.
I can give the cause of a change with debido a and a raíz de.
